_note: Chapters. The game is told in chapters, and the characters aren't shared between them: each chapter has its own player character and its own cast. A chapter ends at its exit door (the island ends on the village's Exit_Cruise), which leads to scenes/chapters/chapter_end.tscn: a full-screen time-jump card ('end_card' of the chapter being left, no year count), then the next chapter's entry scene. On the jump WorldState 'chapter' becomes the next chapter id, the player flags (keys starting with a 'player_flags' prefix: outfit, identity) are archived under 'chapter_archive_<id>' and cleared, so the next chapter starts with a fresh character. The Cruise is the flashback era (DESIGN.md World: the ship before the wreck), so the jump goes back. Its entry is The Interview, the talk-show character creation; 'return_scene' is where the cruise's own scenes go back to (no cruise hub map yet).

end_card.heading: Before the Wreck
lines: The ship on the rocks was a cruise once. Lit up, playing music, going somewhere.
A feminist-themed celebrity cruise. The manifest that became a pantheon.
Nobody on board knows how it ends. Different passengers. A different you.
